title: Convert type
description: Convert with saturating integer rounding; scale maps dtype color ranges.

title: Grayscale
description: RGB luminance with weights .299/.587/.114; ignore alpha.

title: Convert grayscale type (ImageJ)
description: Uncalibrated whole-dataset type conversion with captured range and configurable RGB weights; ignores the active selection.

title: Invert 16-bit
description: Invert unsigned 16-bit pixels using observed extrema or the configured full bit range.

title: Adjust brightness contrast
description: Change actual pixels to (pixel-center)*contrast + center + brightness.

title: Enhance contrast
description: Stretch observed intensities; saturation is total percent clipped.

title: Equalize histogram
description: Global grayscale CDF equalization with first occupied bin subtraction.

title: Color threshold
description: Select pixels whose channels all satisfy their inclusive range bounds.

title: Flip
description: Flip around horizontal and/or vertical axes.

title: Rotate 90 degrees
description: Rotate counterclockwise by turns * 90 degrees, without interpolation.

title: Rotate
description: Rotate counterclockwise about the image center.

title: Resize
description:
Resize with pixel-center nearest, bilinear or Catmull-Rom bicubic sampling.

This resampler does not apply a downsampling antialias filter; use binning
for area aggregation or preblur before reducing resolution.

title: Translate
description: Move pixels right by dx and down by dy.

title: Affine transform
description: Inverse-map output (x,y) to source with a 2x3 matrix; shape is (H,W).

title: Binning
description: Aggregate rectangular bins, including partial edge bins; pairs are (Y,X).

title: Resize canvas
description: Change canvas size and paste the original at offset (x,y).

title: Crop
description: Copy an in-bounds rectangle in (x,y,width,height) coordinates.

title: RGB to HSV
description: Convert RGB to float64 H,S,V in [0,1]; floating RGB must be in [0,1].

title: HSV to RGB
description: Convert normalized H,S,V to the requested RGB dtype.

title: Color deconvolution
description: Return optical-density concentrations for user-provided 3x3 stain rows.

title: Apply lut
description: Map uint8/uint16 pixels through a 256/65536-entry lookup table.

title: Pixel math
description: Apply native scalar math. Integers saturate; floats keep signed results.

title: Invert
description: Invert around 255, 65535 or 1 for uint8, uint16 or floating images.

title: Add
description: Add a scalar to every pixel.

title: Subtract
description: Subtract a scalar from every pixel.

title: Multiply
description: Multiply every pixel by a scalar.

title: Divide
description: Divide pixels by a nonzero scalar.

title: Absolute
description: Take the absolute value of pixels.

title: Square
description: Square pixels.

title: Sqrt
description: Take square roots of nonnegative pixels.

title: Log
description: Natural logarithm of strictly positive pixels.

title: Log1p
description: Natural logarithm of one plus each pixel.

title: Exp
description: Exponentiate pixels; non-finite results raise ValueError.

title: Gamma
description: Apply max_value * (pixel / max_value)**value, with value > 0.

title: Clip
description: Clamp pixel values to an inclusive interval.

title: Smooth
description: Square mean filter with an odd (2*radius+1) window.

title: Directional Shadow (ImageJ)
description: Eight directional 3x3 ImageJ shadow filters; scalar edges replicate, RGB borders remain unchanged.

title: Sharpen
description: Apply the ImageJ-style 3x3 sharpening kernel.

title: Convolve
description: True convolution with an odd 2D kernel; process each channel separately.

title: Gaussian blur (ImageJ)
description: ImageJ numerical profile with nearest edges and ROI-aware sampling; sigma pairs are (Y,X).

title: Gaussian blur
description: Separable Gaussian with radius ceil(4*sigma); pairs are (sigma_y,sigma_x).

title: Remove NaNs (ImageJ)
description: ImageJ Float32 quiet-NaN replacement with a NaN-aware median; preserves finite samples and display.

title: Top Hat (ImageJ)
description: ImageJ finite scalar opening/closing with optional subtraction and paired final display.

title: Remove Outliers (ImageJ)
description: ImageJ finite scalar median replacement with strict threshold and captured LUT polarity.

title: Rank filter (ImageJ)
description: ImageJ 1.54r circular minimum, maximum, median, mean or type-preserving variance; variance adjusts the display range for 16/32-bit images.

title: Rank filter
description: Minimum, maximum, median, mean, variance or stddev in a disk/square.

title: Median filter
description: Median filter; see rank_filter for footprint and border options.

title: Minimum filter
description: Local minimum filter.

title: Maximum filter
description: Local maximum filter.

title: Variance filter
description: Population variance, returned as float64.

title: Unsharp mask
description: Add amount times the difference from the Gaussian-smoothed image.

title: Remove outliers
description: Replace bright/dark pixels differing from the local disk median by threshold.

title: Find edges
description: Sobel gradient magnitude, returned as float64.

title: Laplacian
description: Four-neighbor Laplacian; float64 retains signed derivatives.

title: Difference of gaussians
description: Difference of Gaussian blurs with signed float64 output.

title: Local maxima
description: Disk-neighborhood maxima with nonconstant neighborhoods, as 0/255.

title: Bilateral filter
description: Edge-preserving filter; sigma_range uses the input's intensity units.

title: Kuwahara filter
description: Choose the lowest-variance quadrant's mean; color channels share a quadrant.

title: Anisotropic diffusion
description: Four-neighbor Perona-Malik exponential diffusion, float64 output.

title: Threshold
description: Inclusive intensity interval as a uint8 0/255 grayscale mask.

title: Auto threshold
description: Threshold as pixel > level (bright) or pixel <= level (dark).

title: Local threshold
description:
Adaptive square-window threshold; return uint8 0/255.

Methods are listed in LOCAL_THRESHOLD_METHODS. Float default ranges assume
[0,1]; set dynamic_range when using floats in other intensity units.

title: Morphology
description: Grayscale erosion, dilation, opening, closing, gradient, top_hat or black_hat.

title: Erode
description: Grayscale erosion; set border='constant', cval=0 for a zero exterior.

title: Dilate
description: Grayscale dilation.

title: Opening
description: Erode then dilate.

title: Closing
description: Dilate then erode.

title: Top hat
description: Subtract the morphological opening.

title: Black hat
description: Subtract pixels from the morphological closing.

title: Subtract background
description: Disk opening/closing background subtraction; distinct from rolling ball.

title: Rolling ball background
description:
Direct spherical non-flat opening/closing background, in raw pixel units.

Runtime scales with radius squared. This implements the spherical model
without ImageJ's image shrinking or sliding-paraboloid approximations.

title: Subtract rolling ball
description: Subtract the spherical background; light-background output is background-image.

title: Fill holes
description: Fill background regions disconnected from the image boundary.

title: Erode (binary)
description: Eight-neighbor 0/255 morphology with explicit foreground and edge options.

title: Dilate (binary)
description: Eight-neighbor 0/255 morphology with explicit foreground and edge options.

title: Open (binary)
description: Eight-neighbor 0/255 morphology with explicit foreground and edge options.

title: Close (binary)
description: Eight-neighbor 0/255 morphology with explicit foreground and edge options.

title: Binary outline
description: Eight-neighbor inner boundary of binary foreground.

title: Skeletonize
description: Zhang-Suen thinning with a zero exterior; return uint8 0/255.

title: Remove small objects
description: Keep components with at least min_size pixels.

title: Clear border
description: Remove components touching any image edge.

title: Distance transform
description: Exact Euclidean distance to in-image zeros; all-foreground returns infinity.

title: Binary watershed
Connected components
description: Label nonzero foreground; background=0, labels=int32.

title: Add noise
description:
Gaussian stddev, uniform half-width, or salt_pepper probability.

Seeded output is repeatable within the same C++ standard library.

title: Fft bandpass
description: Gaussian frequency bandpass, in cycles/pixel; zero disables a cutoff.

title: Fill
description: Fill all pixels, or only pixels selected by a nonzero 2D mask.

title: Draw line
description: Draw a solid line between (x,y) pixel-center coordinates.

title: CLAHE local contrast
description: Tiled, bilinearly blended CLAHE for grayscale; tile pairs are (H,W).

title: Image calculator
description:
Combine same-shaped images; dtype can retain values beyond integer range.

Operations: add, subtract, multiply, divide, minimum, maximum, average,
difference, and, or, xor, copy. Division by a zero pixel yields zero.

title: Brush stroke
description: Brush stroke

title: Fill with color
description: Fill with color
